title: Crawford and Al Norris as the band's drinkers
summary: Crawford says he was the ringleader who drank with Al Norris and Willie Smith, while Wilcox drank little.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: What about the other guys in the band? Did they --

Al Norris and myself and Willie Woody Smith, they all died last (inaudible). Al Norris and I, we'd drink anything we could get our hands on. Willie Woody Smith also. He died, unfortunately. He was a great saxophone player. Wilcox didn't do too much of drinking, but that Al Norris and myself, we drank -- we'd drink anything.
